title: Focus group video available
summary: Video from our discussion on how to represent tissue-specific information on the Knowledge Portals is now available.
bodyHtml: In this focus group we discussed the in-development Tissue page of the Knowledge Portals. Even if you didn’t attend the focus group, we would love to hear your opinions on data types and visualizations for tissue-specific data that would be most useful for you! Please let us know your thoughts at help@kp4cd.org.
